sources.news_title: Tires Reportedly Blow Out on Passenger Jet in Denver, Forcing Flight to Abort Takeoff
sources.text: WestJet Flight's Tires Reportedly Blow Out Right Before Takeoff Forcing Pilots to Abort A spokesperson for Denver International Airport confirmed to PEOPLE that an incident involving WestJet Flight 1571 occurred on Thursday, June 18 By Natalia Senanayake Natalia Senanayake Natalia Senanayake is a Writer-Reporter, Lifestyle at PEOPLE. She first joined the brand in 2022. People Editorial Guidelines Published on June 19, 2026 12:53PM EDT Leave a Comment Stock image of a WestJet Airlines plane at Denver International Airport. Credit : Robert Alexander/Getty NEED TO KNOW A WestJet Flight heading to Alberta, Canada, reportedly aborted takeoff in Denver after two landing gear tires blew out on the runwayA spokesperson for Denver International Airport confirmed to PEOPLE that an incident involving WestJet Flight 1571 occurred on Thursday, June 18Passengers were safely deplaned and transported back to the concourse following the incident An incident involving an Alberta, Canada-bound WestJet flight forced the passenger jet to abort takeoff yesterday in Denver. A spokesperson for Denver International Airport (DEN) confirmed to PEOPLE that “an incident took place on Runway 8 with WestJet Flight 1571 at around 12:30 p.m.” on Thursday, June 18. The flight reportedly aborted its takeoff due to two of the tires on its landing gear blowing out on the runway, according to local outlets KDVR, 9 News and Denver 7. Denver International Airport. The crew responded promptly in accordance with established procedures and declared an emergency, with response teams attending immediately,” WestJet said in a statement to KDVR. PEOPLE has reached out to the airline and the Federal Aviation Administration for comment but did not receive an immediate response. The Denver Police Department directed all inquiries to WestJet. It was set to depart from Denver International Airport at 12:08 local time on Thursday and land at the Canadian airport at 2:35 p.m. before it was canceled. Stock image of a WestJet plane. Kennedy Airport (JFK) in New York City, prompting the plane to be met with a large emergency response on Tuesday, June 16. The New York City Fire Department previously confirmed to PEOPLE that Delta Air Lines Flight 1966 from San Juan, Puerto Rico, landed safely at JFK after reports that the plane had two flat front tires. The department added that 46 units and 141 fire and EMS personnel responded to the scene and there were no injuries. "There was some tread wear to one tire," a Delta spokesperson told PEOPLE. sources.news_title: WestJet flight evacuated at DIA after blown tires
Buses getting passengers after 'incident' on plane leaving DIA
Denver International Airport flight aborts takeoff after tires blow
sources.text:
A Canada-bound flight aborted takeoff at Denver International Airport on Thursday afternoon after two tires blew out, forcing passengers to deplane onto the runway, according to air traffic recordings.
WestJet officials confirmed there was an issue involving a flight headed to Calgary, Alberta, Canada, in an emailed statement, but did not detail what happened on board.
The incident happened at around 12:30 p.m., airport spokesperson Ashley Forest said. No one was injured, and Forest referred all other questions to WestJet.
Flight 1571 was scheduled to depart Denver International Airport for Calgary at 12:15 p.m. Thursday, according to flight tracking information from FlightAware. The plane left the gate at 12:08 p.m., but never finished taxiing.
According to recordings of radio communication between air traffic controllers and the pilot shared on ATC.com, the airplane’s two left main gear tires blew out during takeoff. The tires were smoking, but there were no visible flames after the incident, controllers said on the recording.
The Denver Police Department declined to comment on the incident and referred questions to the airport and WestJet. The Denver Fire Department also referred questions to the airport.

sources.news_title: WestJet passengers evacuated on Denver runway after blown tires
WestJet passengers deplaned, bused back to terminal at DIA after 'incident'
sources.text:
Passengers aboard a WestJet plane at Denver International Airport bound for Calgary were deplaned and bused back to the terminal after an aborted takeoff on Thursday afternoon, officials say.
No injuries were reported in the 12:30 p.m. incident, according to an airport spokesperson, who said they could not provide details about what occurred.
Witnesses and Denver police say two of the plane's tires blew during takeoff. WestJet and the Federal Aviation Administration did not respond to requests for information by the time of publication.
This is a developing story that may be updated.
